messages.subject: Match against unicode file
parts:
I want to match words against words in a text file. This works fine, but not with unicode (Arabic) words.
My code:

#############

ui.R
fileInput('TextFile', 'Select textfile', accept=c('text/UTF-8'))

server.R
TextFile<-input$TextFile
if(is.null(threatFile))
      return(NULL)
showScores(TextFile$datapath)

global.R
score.words <- function(sentences, listwords, .progress='none')
{
  require(plyr)
  require(stringr)
  
  scores = laply(sentences, function(sentence, listwords) {
    sentence = gsub('[[:punct:]]', '', sentence)
    sentence = gsub('[[:cntrl:]]', '', sentence)
    sentence = gsub('\\d+', '', sentence)
    word.list = str_split(sentence, '\\s+')
    words = unlist(word.list)
    matches = match(words, listwords)
    # match() returns the position of the matched term or NA
    # we just want a TRUE/FALSE:
    matches = !is.na(matches)
    # and conveniently enough, TRUE/FALSE will be treated as 1/0 by sum():
    score = sum(matches)
    
    return(score)
  }, listwords, .progress=.progress )
  
  scores.df = data.frame(score=scores, text=sentences)
  return(scores.df)
}

showScores <- function(x,y) {
  plus = scan(x,encoding='UTF-8',what='character',sep=',',comment.char=';')
  pluswords <- c(plus)
  text.scores <- score.words(MyDataFrame$content, listwords, .progress='text')
  score <<- text.scores$score
  dd <<- cbind(score,DF)
}

#############

In my Shiny App, I upload a text file (which I have encoded as UTF-8) with words I want to match.
All matching is fine with normal, English words, but when I add Arabic words to the text file, the matching gives no valid results.
What can I do to solve this ?

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Match against unicode file
parts:
You should use the fileEncoding argument instead of encoding in
scan(). You may want to read this article:
http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/unicode.html

Regards,
Yihui
